title: HW-tailored profile binning and pin strategy for A100/H100/L40S/MI300
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: define and publish a reproducible process for creating hardware-specific performance profiles for A100/H100/L40S/MI300 variants, map model-version pinning rules into the model catalog, and automate safe publication + canary rollout. We need profiles that drive routing, autoscale policies, and cost estimates while minimizing regressions during model updates and cross-hardware fallbacks.

Scope:
- Standardize a 'binning' taxonomy for each hardware family (performance buckets + recommended quantization).
- Define pin semantics: model version pin at model-catalog entry with per-hardware variant overrides and explicit compatibility tags.
- Author the performance_profile artifact template and validation checklist used by onboarding automation.
- Implement end-to-end validation harness (microbench + replay + long-run stability) and defined SLO/regression thresholds.
- Document rollout and revert playbook for publishing profiles and pins to hosted/dedicated/private deployments.

Non-goals: full benchmarking of every model variant (this ticket defines the process and produces example artifacts for one seed model). Full on-prem packaging changes are tracked in a follow-up ticket.
acceptance_criteria: A clear binning taxonomy (Gold/Silver/Bronze) defined per hardware family with numeric thresholds for p50/p95 latency, throughput, and memory headroom
A model-catalog pinning schema defined and implemented as metadata keys (pin_version, per_hardware_override, compatibility_tags) with examples
performance_profile JSON artifact template published to model-catalog repo and accepted by onboarding CI (schema validation)
Automated validation pipeline added to onboarding CI that runs microbench, synthetic workload replay, and a 2-hour stability run, failing on defined regressions
Canary publish workflow documented and tested: draft -> 5% canary (dedicated) -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback triggers
Runbook with rollback playbook and fallback mapping matrix (preferred -> fallback_variant) present in the ticket and linked docs
One seeded model (open-model x.y) onboarded using the new process with published profiles for A100/H100/L40S/MI300 and observed metrics posted to dashboard
tasks: Draft binning taxonomy and numeric thresholds for each hardware family
Design model-catalog metadata keys for pin overrides and compatibility tags
Create performance_profile artifact template and JSON schema
Add CI job to validate schema and run microbench harness
Implement synthetic workload replay script and integrate with CI
Run stability test on each hardware family for the seeded model and collect telemetry
Create canary publish automation and rollback rules in the console
Write runbook and publish docs + link dashboard and PRs
